name: r1_doublevb_unfitted
_comment: R1 baseline, corrected. The layout is the thesis's own 14 quads, thirded as the thesis did, and the control points are solved so the limit surface interpolates the layout vertices mapped onto the NURBS. Compare against r1_doublevb_unfitted for what the fit buys and against r1_doublevb_pia for defect 5.
